Method of Attack: Exploits a flaw in Black Basta ransomware encryption algorithm allowing recovery of files by extracting the reused 64-byte keystream used in XOR encryption
Reusing the same keystream during encryption causes zero-byte chunks to reveal the encryption key
Decryptor uses known plaintext attack on 64 encrypted bytes to recover keystream and decrypt files
Impacted Systems: Files encrypted by Black Basta ransomware from November 2022 to about a week before June 2023
Virtual machine disks (VMware ESXi virtual machines)
Corporate networks targeted by Black Basta ransomware
Attack Vector: Black Basta ransomware encryptor exploiting XChaCha20 stream cipher with reused keystream
Double-extortion ransomware attacks on corporate victims
Use of QBot (QakBot) malware and Cobalt Strike beacons for lateral movement and deployment
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with random extensions (not .basta) from November 2022 to June 2023
64-byte chunks of zeros in encrypted files revealing keystream
Presence of Black Basta ransomware activity on corporate networks
Use of Black Basta encryptor versions from November 2022 to about a week before June 2023
